eyebrow: A callout that can't go stale
code:
Top Churn Region Callout =
VAR TopRegion =
  CALCULATETABLE (
    TOPN(1, VALUES(Sales_Customers[Region]), [Churn Rate], DESC),
    ALL(Sales_Customers[Region])
  )
RETURN
  "Churn is concentrated in " &
  CONCATENATEX(TopRegion, Sales_Customers[Region]) &
  " — see drill-down."
caption: A DAX measure, not a text box someone forgot to edit.
